title: Exploiting Synergistic Cognitive Biases to Bypass Safety in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Rewriting harmful instructions by embedding single or synergistic combinations of cognitive biases (e.g., authority bias, anchoring effect, confirmation bias, gambler's fallacy) from a taxonomy of 154 psychological biases, and evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of these adversarial prompts in bypassing LLM safety mechanisms using a GPT-4 judge.
